mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inboundDetail WHERE isDeleted = 0

SELECT i.goodsCode AS goodsCode, g.goodsName AS goodsName, SUM(i.inboundQuantity) AS totalInboundQuantity FROM inboundDetail i LEFT JOIN goods g ON i.goodsCode = g.goodsCode WHERE i.isDeleted = 0 AND i.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY i.goodsCode, g.goodsName ORDER BY totalInboundQuantity DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(i.inboundQuantity) AS quantity FROM inboundDetail i WHERE i.isDeleted = 0 AND i.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT gc.id AS categoryId, gc.categoryName AS categoryName, SUM(i.inboundQuantity) AS totalInbound, 0 AS totalOutbound FROM inboundDetail i LEFT JOIN goods g ON i.goodsCode = g.goodsCode LEFT JOIN goodsCategory gc ON g.categoryId = gc.id WHERE i.isDeleted = 0 AND i.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY gc.id, gc.categoryName ORDER BY totalInbound DESC

SELECT t.date, COALESCE(SUM(i.inboundQuantity), 0) AS totalInbound, COALESCE(SUM(o.outboundQuantity), 0) AS totalOutbound FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date FROM inboundDetail WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date FROM outboundDetail WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ) t LEFT JOIN inboundDetail i ON DATE_FORMAT(i.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') = t.date AND i.isDeleted = 0 LEFT JOIN outboundDetail o ON DATE_FORMAT(o.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') = t.date AND o.isDeleted = 0 GROUP BY t.date ORDER BY t.date ASC
